parent.label: hrafn-fylking:v8
parent.control_rule: C2 changes only the WebSocket heartbeat failure policy in hrafn-chassis-player.mjs. Strategy, state, safety, action selection, public markers, reconnect backoff, and Docker packaging remain byte-identical to the exact v8 source parent.

diagnosis.claim: The first hosted active decision timed out because v8 treated an absent WebSocket pong as proof of connection death, terminated a viable socket, and crossed socket generations before turn 400. This is a client liveness defect, not a slow Hrafn decision.

sequence: match socket missed heartbeat pong; reconnecting
match socket missed heartbeat pong; reconnecting

counterevidence.interpretation: CPU, JSON parsing, image cold start, and strategy evaluation do not explain the exact 15-second misses.

diagnosis.local_reproduction: A WebSocketServer with autoPong disabled reproduces open, ping, forced close, reconnect, and repeated socket churn before any decision request.

retain: actual close and error reconnect behavior
single_delta.expected_runtime_change: An idle healthy socket that exposes no pong remains on one connection and answers the first later active decision within budget.

red_first_gate.fixture: WebSocketServer({ autoPong: false }), HRAFN_HEARTBEAT_MS=50, no spawn request, idle for more than two heartbeat intervals, then send a 12-player-shaped active request.
red_first_gate.current_parent_expected_failure: The parent reconnects before the delayed first request.
candidate_required_pass: first response selects the expected hg35 action within the test budget
clean final message and zero exit

source_requirements: The red test fails against exact v8 and passes after the single delta.
All Hrafn unit, integration, replay-audit, policy-contract, container, and full repository tests pass.
Only hrafn-chassis-player.mjs, its integration test, and evidence records differ from the exact parent.
The exact source commit is pushed before any image build.
local_runtime_requirements: mock no-pong delayed-first-request proof passes inside the built image
normal first-request and real-close reconnect integration tests pass

hosted_scope.minimum_evidence: A fresh Hrafn-only hosted diagnostic must show no pre-decision missed-pong teardown and no first-active-decision timeout.
hosted_scope.reason: C1 already failed its strategic 4/4 gate and exposed a separate deterministic naval-cap hold trap. C2 cannot reopen C1 or become champion regardless of its runtime result.

known_separate_defect.name: naval launch-budget hold trap
known_separate_defect.boundary: No cap-escape, Warship, donation, naval-state, or action-priority change is permitted in C2. That correction requires its own preregistered exact-parent experiment.

verdict: PREREGISTERED: implement and test the runtime-only liveness correction. No upload, submission, membership change, or champion change is authorized by this record.
